mentions.name: Hamilton
mentions.description: This Android app aggregates and displays all of a user's Health Connect data in one place, pulling together information from devices and services such as Garmin watches, Withings scales, Samsung Health nutrition tracking, and Liftosaur workouts. It is priced cheaply with no recurring fees.
mentions.problem: Health data is fragmented across multiple devices and apps (Garmin, Withings, Samsung Health, Liftosaur), with no single place to view it all.
mentions.audience: Android users with Health Connect data from multiple devices and services
mentions.source_excerpt: A vibe-coded app that shows all your Android Health Connect data in one place. I use it daily because I have a garmin watch, withings scale, samsung health for nutrition data, liftosaur for workouts etc.

evidence.value: A vibe-coded app that shows all your Android Health Connect data in one place. I use it daily because I have a garmin watch, withings scale, samsung health for nutrition data, liftosaur for workouts etc.
